validation_ack.reason: Real: reported FY2021 basic EPS 7.03 uses a weighted average of 5,654,375,000 shares (FS2021 Note 32, AR2021 PDF p. 492); 7.03 x 5,654,375,000 = Rp39.75bn = net profit Rp39.748bn. shares_out 5,937,093,750 includes the 282,718,750 PUT III rights shares listed in Dec 2021 (ex-date 30 Nov 2021), which the FS carried as a capital deposit until OJK approval and excluded from EPS; hence the 5% gap. Source: https://bankina.co.id/storage/Laporan%20Tahunan%202021.pdf

Real: reported FY2022 basic EPS 26.45 uses a weighted average of 5,937,093,750 shares (FS2022 Note 33, AR2022 PDF p. 510); 26.45 x 5,937,093,750 = Rp157.04bn = net profit Rp157.048bn. shares_out 6,134,716,665 includes the 197,622,915 PMHMETD IV shares listed in Dec 2022 (ex-date 9 Dec 2022), carried as a capital deposit at year end and excluded from EPS; hence the 3.3% gap. Source: https://bankina.co.id/storage/Laporan%20Tahunan%202022.pdf

research_notes: SOURCE ACCESS: bankina.co.id (Next.js site) serves every current document directly from https://bankina.co.id/storage/<file name>.pdf; no bot challenge was met. The old pre-2023 site paths (/media/file/originals/post/...) now return 404; the two rights-issue disclosures were fetched from Internet Archive snapshots of those exact URLs (see sources.md). The full prospectuses of PUT III and PMHMETD IV are archived only as truncated 1 MB captures and were not used. The bank-hosted files "Keterbukaan Informasi PUT IIII.pdf", "Keterbukaan Informasi Rencana HMETD.pdf" and "Keterbukaan Informasi Pemegang Saham Tertentu.pdf" are all the same wrong upload (an IDX volatility query of 8 Apr 2020). idx.co.id was not needed.

NO SUBSIDIARIES: Bank INA files stand-alone (not consolidated) audited statements; every money figure is the bank figure, tagged basis "consolidated" per the schema, and equity_attr = total_equity. FY figures come from the audited FS reproduced inside each year's annual report (the IR page lists the AR under "Laporan Keuangan Tahunan"); separate Dec-2022..Dec-2025 FS files (titled "Laporan Keuangan Interim 31 Desember") exist and agree. Ratios come from the December OJK published reports (bank only) and match the AR five-year tables. No restatement of any stored FY figure was found in the following year's comparatives; FY2020 equity includes the 1 Jan 2020 PSAK 71 adjustment of Rp(65,173) juta.

RIGHTS ISSUES (the only share-count actions since 2019; no split, reverse split, bonus issue or stock dividend - AR2019-AR2025 "Aksi Korporasi" sections): PUT III ex 30 Nov 2021 (20:1 at Rp4,200, fully taken, +282,718,750 shares) and PMHMETD IV ex 9 Dec 2022 (20:1 at Rp4,050, 197,622,915 of 296,854,687 taken). PUT II (2,929,375,000 shares at Rp240) dates from Feb 2017, before the 2019 window; its shares were only reclassified into share capital after OJK approval on 20 Feb 2020 (so the FY2019 balance sheet shows 2,725,000,000 issued shares although ~5.65bn were listed and used for EPS). The AR2025 FS Note 1b misprints the PUT III price as Rp240; the AR2021 FS note, the AR chronology tables and the proceeds (Rp1,187.4bn) confirm Rp4,200. fy.2019.year_end_price is stored only as an extra anchor: no rights issue went ex before 2020-12-31.

SHARES_OUT vs EPS (FY2021, FY2022): each rights issue closed in December and its proceeds were carried as "dana setoran modal" (capital deposit) until OJK approval in the following year, so the audited balance sheet and EPS use the pre-rights count while the new shares were already listed. shares_out uses the listed count from FS Note 1b (5,937,093,750 at Dec 2021; 6,134,716,665 at Dec 2022), which matches equity (it contains the deposit). Both eps x shares gaps are acknowledged in validation_ack.

AR SHARE TABLES print "Jumlah Saham Beredar" as 99% of the issued count (5,597,831,250 / 5,877,722,813 / 6,073,369,498), i.e. the PP 29/1999 1% unlisted convention, although FS Note 1b says 100% are listed from Dec 2021. The FS count is used for shares_out.

DIVIDENDS: none. Every AGMS from FY2019 (5 Jun 2020) to FY2025 (5 Jun 2026) retained the whole result to strengthen capital; FY2025 was a net loss of Rp369.0bn. payout_ratio is stored as v 0 for FY2020-FY2025 with the AGMS summary as source; the statements of changes in equity 2019-2025 show no dividend line and AR2025 PDF p. 160 confirms no distribution.

LOSS YEAR FY2025: net loss Rp(369,018) juta after impairment provisions of Rp601,993 juta (FY2024: 188,899). ROE -10.89%, ROA -1.72%, BOPO 122.70% and EPS -60.15 are real. KPMM fell to 19.30% (Dec 2025) and 14.79% (Sep 2026); 9M2026 shows a further unrealised FVOCI loss of Rp(366,515) juta in OCI, so equity fell to Rp3,016bn even though 9M profit rose to Rp72.8bn (loan write-off recoveries Rp138bn).
RATIOS OUTSIDE THE VALIDATOR'S RANGE THAT ARE REAL: FY2021 LDR 29.67% (< 30): loans Rp3.7tn vs deposits Rp12.5tn after Salim-group deposit inflows. All others are inside the ranges.

RATIO GAPS: CoC and loan-at-risk are not disclosed for any FY; NPL coverage and CASA for FY2025 come from the Public Expose 2026 deck (Q1 2026; image-only PDF read visually at PDF pp. 10-11). CASA is printed for FY2021 (42.39%) and FY2024 (24.5%) only; FY2022 is printed only as separate giro/tabungan shares (31.39% + 3.57%) and is left null. No analyst presentations exist on the IR page before 2026.

INTERIM: 9M2026 (30 Sep 2026) unaudited interim FS (posted 2 Nov 2026) + Sep-2026 OJK published report. The 9M2025 interim FS is not on the IR page, so loans_gross_prior and deposits_prior come from the Sep-2025 published report (deposits_prior = sum of the three printed deposit rows). The Sep-2026 report is the first in the POJK 18/2025 format and adds the KKR row, stored as lar (12.37%).

PRIVATE PLACEMENT 2026 (not a schema corporate-action type, so not in corporate_actions): the Independent GMS of 5 Jun 2026 approved a PMTHMETD of up to 80,000,000 new shares (<= 1.30% of paid-up shares); the bank announced execution on 3 Nov 2026 with results due 5 Nov 2026 (Pengumuman Rencana Pelaksanaan PMTHMETD, 27 Oct 2026). After that, shares_out will be up to 6,214,716,665; re-check the 5 Nov 2026 result before using a post-September share count.

SELF-CHECK: eps x shares_out vs net profit: 2020 +0.1%, 2021 +5.0% (ack), 2022 +3.3% (ack), 2023 +0.0%, 2024 -0.0%, 2025 +0.0%. payout 0 and no dividend records in every year. Deposits / loans tie to the AR five-year table (AR2025 PDF p. 32) and the December published reports.
